title: viburnum triphyllum f. macrophyllum
intro: Viburnum triphyllum f. macrophyllum, commonly known as large-leaf arrowwood, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Adoxaceae family. Large-leaf arrowwood is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of large-leaf arrowwood are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which may exhibit antioxidant, antispasmodic, and anti-allergic activities. Further research is necessary to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of Viburnum triphyllum f. macrophyllum.
